segments.name: Insurance
segments.description: A holding company that acquires, owns and actively manages insurance and technology-focused businesses, generating commission-based revenues from insurance sales.
segments.evidence: Reliance operates as a single operating segment.

revenueModel.text: The Company earns commissions from insurance carriers and members for the sale and servicing of insurance products, plus contingent commissions based on carrier targets.
revenueModel.evidence: We own and operate insurance agencies and related platforms that generate commission-based revenues through the sale and servicing of insurance products.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company sold certain insurance brokerage assets, including the Fortman Insurance Services, Employee Benefits Solutions and US Benefits Alliance businesses.
changes.evidence: During 2025, the Company completed the sale of certain insurance brokerage assets, including the Fortman Insurance Services business and the Employee Benefits Solutions and US Benefits Alliance businesses.

changes.text: In 2025, the previously announced agreement to acquire Spetner Associates, Inc. was terminated.
changes.evidence: In July 2025, the previously announced agreement to acquire Spetner Associates, Inc. was terminated.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company adopted a digital asset treasury strategy allocating a portion of treasury assets to cryptocurrencies.
changes.evidence: In September 2025, the Company adopted a digital asset treasury strategy pursuant to which it may allocate a portion of its treasury assets to cryptocurrencies and related blockchain initiatives.
